name: nemesis
description: Monorepo nemesis (nom de code) : information voyageur pour le transport en commun en Côte d'Ivoire.

scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter @nemesis/openapi run build && pnpm -r run typecheck
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @nemesis/openapi run build && pnpm -r --workspace-concurrency=1 run test
scripts.proto:lint: buf lint packages/proto && buf format packages/proto --diff --exit-code
scripts.openapi:lint: pnpm --filter @nemesis/openapi run lint:openapi && pnpm --filter @nemesis/openapi run types:check
